title: Ebola virus disease in Liberia
summary: As of 29 March, seven clinical samples, all from adult patients from Foya district, Lofa County, have been tested by PCR using Ebola Zaire virus primers by the mobile laboratory of the Institut Pasteur (IP) Dakar in Conakry.

title: Ebola virus disease in Guinea – update
summary: The Ministry of Health of Guinea has today reported 4 laboratory confirmed cases of Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the capital, Conakry.

title: Ebola virus disease in Guinea – update
summary: The total number of suspected cases in the ongoing Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Guinea remains 86. Two more cases died bringing total deaths to 62 (CFR: 72%).
